plan: A marksman who hops after every attack and plants spears that she rips out all at once.
aSurveiller: Her E (Rend). Each attack plants a spear; she rips them all out at once for big damage: don't let her hit you for long.
contrer: Don't let her hit you for long: every spear planted makes her E stronger.
Slow her: she hops as she attacks; slowed, she can't escape anymore.
Her R throws her ally at you: back off when he disappears near her.
forces: Her R can save her support.

sorts.Q: Spear that passes through enemies it kills.
sorts.W: Sends a sentinel; bonus damage with her ally.
sorts.E: Rips out the planted spears and slows.
sorts.R: Pulls her ally to her and throws them at enemies.

momentFort: Strong at level 6 with her R. If she ends the early game even, her 2 or 3 item spike is one of the strongest in the game.
